Cookies are small text files that are stored in your browser when you visit a website. They are widely used for the proper functioning of websites, as well as for collecting information about user behavior.

2. Categories of Cookies We Use

    They collect anonymous data about how visitors use the website, with the aim of improving the user experience (e.g., Google Analytics).

    Allow the website to remember your choices (e.g., language, region) to provide personalized features.

  • Targeted Advertising Cookies

For any questions regarding the Cookie Policy, you can contact us at info@kolleris.com.
